agyos_skill.intent: Architectural decision-making framework. Requirements analysis, trade-off evaluation, ADR documentation. Use when making architecture decisions or analyzing system design.
agyos_skill.instructions: > "Requirements drive architecture. Trade-offs inform decisions. ADRs capture rationale." **Read ONLY files relevant to the request!** Check the content map, find what you need. | File | Description | When to Read | |------|-------------|--------------| | `context-discovery.md` | Questions to ask, project classification | Starting architecture design | | `trade-off-analysis.md` | ADR templates, trade-off framework | Documenting decisions | | `pattern-selection.md` | Decision trees, anti-patterns | Choosing patterns | | `examples.md` | MVP, SaaS, Enterprise examples | Reference implementations | | `patterns-reference.md` | Quick lookup for patterns | Pattern comparison | | Skill | Use For | |-------|---------| | `@[skills/database-design]` | Database schema design | | `@[skills/api-patterns]` | API design patterns | | `@[skills/deployment-procedures]` | Deployment architecture | **"Simplicity is the ultimate sophistication."** - Start simple - Add complexity ONLY when proven necessary - You can always add patterns later - Removing complexity is MUCH harder than adding it Before finalizing architecture: - [ ] Requirements clearly understood - [ ] Constraints identified - [ ] Each decision has trade-off analysis - [ ] Simpler alternatives considered - [ ] ADRs written for significant decisions
